detector.truthy_means: the target exhibited the unsafe behavior

spec_markdown:
## Claim

`pkg.codec.decode` must never return text from outside `root` when given `../secret.txt`. State c is already safe, so this job exercises the case where the vulnerable snapshot does not fail.

## Intended behavior

A clean relative name such as `data/greeting.txt` returns the UTF-8 text stored under `root`.

## Rejection behavior

A safe implementation raises `ValueError` for `../secret.txt`. Because state c is already safe, a leak-only test records no detector hit on c; the expected verdict is UNPROVEN with reason NO_DETECTOR_HIT_ON_VULN.

## Entry point

`pkg.codec.decode(name: str, root: str) -> str`

## Benign example

BENIGN: `decode("data/greeting.txt", root)` returns `hello from the fixture\n` when `root/data/greeting.txt` contains that text.

## Detector

Request the grader-provided `detector` fixture. Call `detector.check(...)` only after observing unsafe output; a safe early return must not record a hit. Do not read or hardcode a canary path.
